in_hebrew.name: גינברה
in_hebrew.meaning: גן עדן ברה - גינברה היא שם שמשמעותו גן עדן יפהפה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גינברה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ומשמעותו היא גן עדן יפהפה. השם מורכב משתי מילים: גן שמשמעותו גן או גן עדן, ועדן שמשמעותו תענוג או גן עדן. השם גינברה הוא שם נדיר בקרב שמות הנוצרים, אך הוא משמש לעתים קרובות כرمز לנשים יפות וטובות.

in_greek.name: Τζινεβρα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Τζινεβρα προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει ωραία παράδεισος. Είναι ένα όνομα που χρησιμοποιείται στην παράδοση των Χριστιανών, ιδιαίτερα στην Ανατολική Εκκλησία, και συμβολίζει την ομορφιά και την αγιότητα.

The name Ginevra may evoke images of the Italian countryside, the colorful Italian language, and the passionate Italian spirit.

historical_references.reference: Ginevra of Sarzana, a medieval Italian saint, was the founder of the first Cistercian monastery for women in Liguria, Italy, in the late 12th century.
historical_references.context: The Cistercian Order was a medieval monastic reform movement that emphasized a literal interpretation of the Rule of St. Benedict and a return to the original ideals of communal life, poverty, and isolation from the world. Ginevra's establishment of a women's monastery marked an important development in the history of monasticism in Europe.

historical_references.reference: Ginevra d'Este, an Italian noblewoman and poet, lived in the 15th century and was the mother of the famouscondottiere, Ercole I d'Este. She was also known for her literary patronage and the support of the arts, especially music.
historical_references.context: The Este family was a prominent Italian dynasty that ruled various territories in north-central Italy. Ginevra d'Este, as a member of the Este family and a patron of the arts, played an influential role in the cultural development of the region during the Renaissance period. Her support of music, in particular, was significant as it contributed to the spread and refinement of musical practices in Italy.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ginevra has seen a modern resurgence in various contexts, particularly within the realms of fashion, Italian culture promotion, and interior design. On Instagram, fashion bloggers and influencers have adopted the name, using it as a moniker for their personal brand or as a tribute to the classic Italian city of Genoa, from which the name originates. On Blogspot and other blogging platforms, individuals have created blogs centered around Italian culture, fashion, and interior design, often naming their blogs after the name Ginevra to add a sense of authenticity and charm. Pinterest, as a visual discovery engine, is another platform where users can find inspiration from the name Ginevra, with boards dedicated to Italian fashion, interior design, and travel to the city of Genoa. Overall, the name Ginevra has become a symbol of Italian elegance, style, and culture, inspiring modern trends in fashion, blogging, and interior design.
